messages:
Anna (Infra PM): quick follow-up from the all-hands — can leadership clarify the preemptible/spot fallback plan for APAC over the upcoming holiday window? slide mentioned 'regional fallbacks' but not the prioritization (latency vs cost). cc @Tom :question:

Tom (VP Infra): good ask. short answer: latency-sensitive customer tiers get region-first, cost-sensitive workloads will route to cheaper preemptible pools with best-effort latency. longer answer below. :wave:

Mike (SRE Lead): FYI the autoscaler has two hard knobs now: `fallback_policy` (values: `prefer_region`, `prefer_cost`) and `min_warm` (int). default for hosted customers is `prefer_region` + `min_warm=2` for APAC.

Sara (GSW Eng): is `min_warm` per-zone or per-region? wondering how this interacts with model sharding.

Mike (SRE Lead): per-region. we maintain warm instances across 3 zones where available. model shards still placed per-node as before — fallback only changes where new requests land, not KV placement.

Anna (Infra PM): to be explicit: Dedicated customers can pin `prefer_cost` if they want cheaper fallbacks, but we recommend `prefer_region` for production latency SLAs. we'll add a toggle in the console next week.

Raj (Platform): operational note — during the last holiday spike we saw a 30% higher preempt rate in APAC. autoscaler will now proactively spill to a regional burst pool when preempt_rate > 0.15 for 3 consecutive minutes. config excerpt we pushed to staging: `{"preempt_threshold":0.15,"spill_window_s":180,"fallback_policy":"prefer_region"}`

Elena (Eng): any guidance for test harnesses? we want to simulate preempt storms to validate client retry/backoff.

Mike (SRE Lead): yes — use the harness in infra/tools/preempt-sim. example command: `./preempt-sim --region=apac1 --spike=0.4 --duration=300` will simulate a 40% preempt spike for 5m. add `--observe` to dump headers and KV miss rates.

ops-bot: deploy-bot rolled `autoscaler/v2` to staging at 2024-02-19T18:04:22Z — watch staging-autoscale metrics. :robot_face:

Anna (Infra PM): follow-up items I captured: 1) docs for console toggle (Raj) 2) add `min_warm` visibility to per-route metrics (Mike) 3) playbook entry for holiday spill (Elena) — I'll ping owners.

Tom (VP Infra): heads-up for leadership: for Dedicated enterprise customers we will offer a "guaranteed regional capacity" add-on (paid) — it's effectively a regional warm pool with SLA. details next week.

Sara (GSW Eng): quick question on billing: if a request spills to a cheaper preemptible pool but falls back to warm later, which invoice line shows up?

Raj (Platform): billing will tag by node class. spill events are annotated `node_tag=spill-preempt` in usage logs; billing maps those to the cheaper SKU. we'll publish a small FAQ.

Elena (Eng): noting an action: I'll author the holiday playbook draft and post in #eng-oncall by EOD Friday.

Anna (Infra PM): thanks all. if anyone else saw the all-hands and has a follow-up, drop it here — I'll consolidate and send a short summary to leadership. :memo:

Mike (SRE Lead): one more ops tip — if you run latency-critical tests, set `fallback_policy=prefer_region` in your test config to avoid noisy neighbor spillovers.

Tom (VP Infra): closing note: we recognize APAC supply is still constrained; procurement is prioritizing additional boards in Q2. we may open a short dedicated pilot for 2-3 customers to validate the regional warm pool economics.

Anna (Infra PM): noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
